Acknowledgment type for the given command. Value is a comma
separated list of one or more of the following: none, received,

If specified with an AMPS command which requests an
acknowledgment message, all non-conflated requested
acknowledgment messages will contain the command_id in the
ack response header. Notice that AMPS may conflate successful
persisted acknowledgments for publishes.
